summary: Establish EKODIBIZ as the exclusive commercial subject for all revenue businesses operated through the EKODI platform while limiting ordinary-user platform access to information, recommendation, comparison, reminders and managed-service referral.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly instructed that all EKODI revenue businesses use EKODIBIZ as the revenue subject and that ordinary users receive limited information-oriented functions across channels.
evidence: Benefit Radar public/quasi-public institution information expansion
generationImpact: None. Generation 10 remains the active baseline.
scaleImpact: None. Current scale tier remains unchanged.
authorityImpact: Narrows commercial execution authority to explicitly authorized EKODIBIZ operator roles; does not grant AI or ordinary users additional sovereign authority.
rollback: Revert Constitution v1.12.0 commercialSubjectPolicy, Revenue Engine exclusive-subject enforcement, ordinary-user information-only surface changes and related tests through the guarded release path. Existing external user-owned businesses and non-commercial platform access remain unaffected.
